configuration_rationale: Extend the passed Q1 matched measurement path to the unchanged existing Q0 benchmark query on a new verified SF1 clone with the same measured-file-count intervention and original-snapshot matching. Q0 previously had shorter actual service time, so missed overlap is a real risk and remains failed evidence; no artificial query slowdown, delay, data growth or weakened task gate. Retain original observation/row/metadata/result gates and 06:15 IST physical cutoff. One Q0 episode broadens query coverage but is not independent variance estimation, common-support/load diversity or cost-model training. Atomic binpack action and operational polling settings remain unchanged; no policy/forecast/model decision.

telemetry.rationale: One-second real host counter cadence, five-minute warmup plus five-second margin; retain existing 95% coverage and two-second gap/freshness gates. Exact bounds/available frontier and actual submission freshness are independently checked. No normalized demand assumed.
